title: Theme
description: pixelbar/<target>/theme, retained. A holiday scene in place of the idle sky. An empty payload goes back to the weather.

theme.description: A holiday scene in place of the weather sky. An empty message goes back to the weather.

parts.description: Tunes the scene, part by part: { "leaves": { "amount": 200, "speed": 50 }, "fireworks": { "on": false } }. Which parts there are depends on the theme.

amount.description: How many, as a percentage of the usual: 50 is half as many, 200 twice as many, 0 none.

speed.description: How fast it moves, as a percentage of the usual: 0 holds it still.

size.description: How big, as a percentage of the usual.

colors.description: Its own colours as #RRGGBB, used in turn, in place of the theme's.
